title: The nominal style
description: Verbal nouns in -nie and -cie, typical of official, academic and news language.

blocks.text: Almost every Polish verb has a verbal noun ending in -nie or -cie: czytać gives czytanie, pić gives picie, zamknąć gives zamknięcie. These nouns are neuter and decline like other nouns. Official, academic and news Polish uses them heavily, turning actions into things: instead of Kiedy zamknięto drogę, powstały korki, a report says Zamknięcie drogi spowodowało korki. In speech, the verbal style is usually more natural.

blocks.translation: The closure of the road caused traffic jams.
